programme.desc: Nick and Sally are trying out their new, blue rubber boots but they keep getting stuck in the mud! Later, Nick has difficulty learning a "disappearing" magic trick.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Phew, it's hot outside! Cat suggests that they should visit some friends in the Dizzle-dazzle Desert to learn how to keep cool. Later, Sally, Nick, and Cat visit Themba the African elephant.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Flutter By Butterfly / Pretty in Pink
programme.desc: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to meet Bernadette the Monarch Butterfly. Later, the kids are having fun trying out different moves when the Cat arrives to show them some cool moves of his own.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are exploring how deep they can dig in the sandbox. Later, Nick and Sally are excited to jump in the giant puddle in their backyard - but it's gone!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: It's Fish's birthday and Nick and Sally want to get him a special present... but who can they ask for ideas? Later, Nick and Sally are playing when their ball gets caught up in the branches of a tree!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Trick or Treat / King Cecil the Seahorse
programme.desc: It's Halloween! The Cat in the Hat takes Sally and Nick trick or treating - his way! Later, Sally is off to fight the 'dragon' while Nick must stay and watch the baby princess.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally set off on a safari with The Cat in the Hat to find all kinds of stripes. Later, Nick wants to learn how to knit a scarf like Sally but they've run out of wool!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: A Sweet Deal / King of Swing
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are having a hard time getting customers to come to their 'café'. What can they do? Later, The Cat takes them to meet the King of Swing, Charlie the Chimpanzee!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to guess which game Harvey the Guinea Pig might like to play with them. Later, Nick and Sally wait for Mum to come back so they can play in the pool.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are cleaning up the backyard when they come across a yucky apple core. Later, Nick and Sally go off to the Drippety Dry Desert.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: The Cat brings Sally and Nick to meet some great sneaker-uppers - cats! Later, Nick and Sally are making their 'Best Ever Yummy For Your Tummy' muffins when they realise they don't have enough flour.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are planning to camp out in the backyard but there are some scary noises out there! Later, Nick and Sally plan to make a leaf collage of Cat.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Hooray for Hair / Ice is Nice
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are getting their hair cut today; maybe they should try new hairstyles! Later, Nick and Sally want some nice cold lemonade but there's no more ice cubes in Sally's fridge!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: When I Grow Up / Doing It Differently
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to guess what they'll be when they grow up when the Cat drops in for a visit. Later, Nick and Sally can't seem to find Harvey the Guinea Pig.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Seasons - Spring and Summer / Autumn and Winter
programme.desc: For Show and Tell at school, Nick and Sally must bring something from their favourite season. But how can they choose which is their favourite?

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Jumping on the Moon / Sneezy Riders
programme.desc: Nick and Sally try to jump high enough to touch the moon, but "what goes up must come down" says the Cat. Then, Sally and Nick play hide and seek, but Nick keeps sneezing!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick keeps trying to surprise Sally, but he just can't do it! The Cat takes them to find a real surprise in the Skippylarito Fields! Then, the kids hear chirping but can't find where it's coming from.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally wonder why their ball is so bouncy. Then, Nick and Sally are playing on a climbing frame but just can't manage to get to the top.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: No Night Today / Fun in the Sun
programme.desc: Nick and Sally want to keep playing, but it's getting dark. Why does nighttime have to come? The Cat knows someone who can answer that question. Then, the kids visit Muddymoo River.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally must protect their cookie jar from cookie snatchers! Then, the kids meet Treetop Tom and see how his tough tongue can pick food off of thorny branches.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Manatees and Mermaids / The Last Chocolate
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are pretending to swim but "why not go for a real swim" asks the Cat! Later, the children go on a trip to visit Princess Lottachoca in the Cocoalicious Forest.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Tough Enough / How Cool is Coral
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are try to guess what animal is the toughest one. Then, the Cat needs to get his fish friend, Ting Tang Tony, back to his family.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick go on a trip to Ozzie-Wozz Outback to help them look after some baby hamsters. Then, Nick and Sally wish they could go as fast as an airplane!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: It's cold outside, but Nick and Sally want to keep playing. Is there a way to stay warm out in the cold? Then, Nick and Sally visit Dr. Giggles.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick try to stump each other by guessing the animal sounds they're making. Then, Sally plays dress up but her favourite hat no longer has any feathers on it! Where can they find more?

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are practising for a three-legged race, but walking on three legs is hard! Then, the kids visit Dr. Twiggles in Fluff'n Stuff Fields.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick's hungry tummy is rumbling! But why do our stomachs make noises when they're hungry? Then, Nick and Sally help Cat put his model of the solar system back together!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Step This Way / Anything You Can Do
programme.desc: The Cat takes the kids to the Jungle of Bingle-Bungle Boo to meet his friends Emily the Teal, Mikey the Lemur and Greg the Gecko. Then, Nick and Sally pretend to be The Cat in the Hat.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Gorillas in the Nest / Tale of a Dragon
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are off to the Twisty-Misty Mountains to meet Gordon the Gorilla. Cat knows some lizard friends who are oh-so like dragons. They can show Nick and Sally how to pretend to be dragons.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Top of the Sky / Jiggle Bones
programme.desc: Sally, Nick and Cat are playing with their toy rocket. Then, Nick and Sally are wiggling and jiggling like the jelly mould in front of them.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to wrap a present for their mums but they're having problems. Then, there's a frog in Nick and Sally's pool! They have to get him out but can't catch him...

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are making paper airplanes but have run out of paper! Then, Nick and Sally lose Teddy outside.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to walk across a beam in their backyard but are having trouble staying on it! Then, the kids are playing with glass marbles until one of them rolls away!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nickgo to Savannah Saloo to meet Os the Ostrich. Then, Nick and Sally are trying to make some music but they need drums.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: The Skin I'm In / Fishy Washy
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are playing super heroes when Nick cuts his finger. Then, it's off to the ocean to meet this cleaner fish!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Whatever Floats Your Boat / Building Bridges
programme.desc: When Nick and Sally's boat sinks, they need to build another boat, but don't know how. Then, in Spansylvania, they meet a dragon who chases after them!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Accidents Happen... If You're Lucky / Making Waves
programme.desc: The Cat takes Sally and Nick to meet Sara of Serendip, an inventor who helps them understand that you can make new discoveries through your mistakes. Then, the Cat takes them to the Soundy Sea.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: The kids want to get a trunk up into the treehouse and go to the Machine-a-Ma-Zoo, where they're introduced to simple machines. Then, Sally loses her "slidiness"!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are having a sleepover in the treehouse and Nick is startled by a shadow. Then, Nick unintentionally loses Sally's bouncy ball.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: The Search for String / Mirror Mirror
programme.desc: Nick and Sally need a strong piece of string to pull their train but it breaks and they don't have anything stronger. Later, they notice a bird flying back and forth into the tree branches.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to the Magnetic Fields where they learn how magnets work. Later, Nick tries to learn how to ride his bike.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Who Can See the Wind? / Gravity Drop
programme.desc: Sally wants to fly her kite but can't seem to work out the timing to get the wind right. Later, Cat takes Nick and Sally to Gravity Drop.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Nick's Cricket / Go With the Flow
programme.desc: The Cat takes Nick and Sally on a journey but has to make an emergency landing on Lagoona-Maroon. Later, Nick and Sally go to a water park and learn that water always seeks the lowest level.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally is trying to make a vase for her mother but each one she tries falls over. Later, the Cat takes Nick and Sally to Arcade Island where they discover what will and won't be attracted to a magnet.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: The Cat takes Sally and Nick to Machine-a-Ma-Zoo where they learn how a lever can solve their problem. Then, in Gongolia, they find out that bigger things make lower sounds.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally keeps getting found when they play Hide and Seek. Cat takes them to Tagaloo to meet a great seeker. Then, Cat takes them to the Hole-Lot-of Funhouse.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: Bump Bump Bump Around / Snow Difference
programme.desc: When Nick's magic trick causes his toy car to disappear under the porch, the Cat takes them to Arcade Island to win a Grasper-ma-clasper. Then, Cat takes them to Coldsnap Island.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.sub-title: All Sorts of Things / Bubble Trouble

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: When Nick's water glass suddenly falls over without anyone touching it, Cat comes to help them solve the mystery. Then, Cat takes them to the Jingly Jungle for a concert by the great Vibrato.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!

programme.desc: Yvette starts the new series with an investigation at the haunted Eden Camp. Strange noises and an unknown force try to separate the team. Can they endure the entire investigation, or will the paranormal activity prove too much for them to handle?

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E02 - Eden Camp Museum Part 2
programme.desc: Yvette and her world-famous team continue investigating Eden Camp. Splitting into lone vigils, they quickly regret it as lost souls, dark shadows, and disembodied voices haunt this living museum, all eager to make their presence known.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E01 - Operation Caviar
programme.desc: Wardens from Region 7 gather at the Intake fishing area on the Yellowstone River just as the yearly paddlefish migration is happening. Check out anglers trying to catch paddlefish and wardens catching those breaking the rules!

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E02 - Operation Camper
programme.desc: Tongue River Reservoir State Park in south-central Montana is a hot spot in the summer for folks who love to have fun and fish. Warden Mike Krings stays busy making sure everyone gets along, especially when night falls.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E04 - Treestand Nightmare
programme.desc: When avid bow hunter, Dr. Joe Baumgardner sets out to do routine maintenance on his tree stands, a twenty two foot fall leaves him with a severely broken leg and miles from help in the deep Mississippi woods.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a “blank cheque” when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.
